purpose: A stratified matched categorical-domain interface diagnostic, separate from the full 667-item and 297-item evaluations.
selection: For every suite/WG/family cell, minimize SHA256(anchor UTF-8), breaking ties by item ID. Selection does not inspect outputs or score values.
modelIdentity: Use actual returned modelUsage keys; stop comparisons across different IDs. No fallback model.
generation: One fresh session per language/repetition, all five WG schemas inline; first response only; no tools, customization, skills, MCP, database access, or execution feedback. No output-informed retries.
authentication: claude.ai firstParty Max subscription verified with claude auth status; API key/auth token/custom base URL/provider flags absent; apiKeyHelper absent. --bare is forbidden because it skips OAuth.
domains: Native categorical values for the eight listed SQL columns and ten listed graph properties; identical joint appendix is supplied to both languages. SQL is measured from frozen read-only exports; graph values are from existing measured packet records. No high-cardinality examples or answer identifiers.
scoring: Gold is withheld from all writer prompts and visible only to the separate scorer. Exact unordered row-set match and row-set F1; strip/lower-case and recorded meeting spelling normalization only. Every first query is executed once per run; no feedback, repair, or scoring of translated substitutes.

runtimes.neo4j: existing services only; read transactions; 60 second transaction timeout

servicePolicy: No service start, restart, or configuration change. Unavailable execution is recorded as blocked.
claims: Descriptive results on 50 fixed strata representatives, not a new estimate for the 667/297-item populations, not an isolated causal estimate of domains, and not a replacement for historic model conditions.
systemPrompt: You are an independent query writer. Use only the supplied questions, schema, and categorical-domain appendix. Produce executable read-only queries. You have no tools, database access, prior answers, execution feedback, or examples of correct queries. Return only the requested JSON object.
